description: This PHP source file defines the class SystemAdminThemePreprocess, which implements various hook functions for preprocessing theme and module administration pages in Drupal. It handles preparing variables for templates related to admin blocks, module details, themes, and security advisories.

classes.name: SystemAdminThemePreprocess
classes.description: A class implementing hook functions for preprocessing Drupal admin theme pages, handling variables for admin blocks, module details, themes, and security advisories.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for theme extension list, module extension list, renderer, module handler, and current user.

methods.name: preprocessAdminBlockContent
methods.description: Prepares variables for admin block content templates, generating links and descriptions for admin menu items.

methods.name: preprocessAdminPage
methods.description: Prepares variables for admin page templates, organizing blocks into left/right containers with automatic striping.

methods.name: preprocessSystemAdminIndex
methods.description: Prepares variables for the system admin index page, organizing modules into left/right containers with descriptions.

methods.name: preprocessSystemModulesDetails
methods.description: Prepares variables for module detail templates, including dependency and requirement information, and theme dependencies.

methods.name: preprocessSystemModulesUninstall
methods.description: Prepares variables for module uninstall templates, listing modules with validation and requirement info.

methods.name: preprocessSystemThemesPage
methods.description: Prepares variables for themes page, organizing themes into groups, handling screenshots, descriptions, compatibility, and operations.

methods.name: preprocessSystemSecurityAdvisoriesFetchErrorMessage
methods.description: Prepares error message variables for security advisories fetch failures, including links to logs and documentation.
